records.title: M3-T11-122 — Phi fresh difference squareclass collapse and twist-support firewall
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-122 — Phi fresh difference squareclass collapse and twist-support firewall


STATUS=PROVED_EXACT_STRUCTURE / WITHIN_SESSION_HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS / SUPPORT_RECEIVER_NO_GO / NO_NEW_COUNTING_CREDIT
TYPE=EXACT_STRUCTURE / GLOBAL_FRESH_SQUARECLASS_COLLAPSE / NEGATIVE_RESULT / ANTI_LOOP_FIREWALL
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet, restricted to the retained phi / 1+3 image. One physical endpoint is one count.
HEIGHT=Exact physical R<=B retained. No raw square-box replacement and no independent density assumption.
DEPENDS_ON=M3-T11-040 exact Q_S*C_u=M_rel^2 conductor partition; M3-T11-099/100 hostile-audit-passed interior tuple saturation; M3-T11-102 hostile-audit-passed v_p(Pi)=-4lambda and Pi=4u^2*S/(1+u^2); M3-T11-105 hostile-audit-passed S4/norm-only firewall; M3-T11-109/110 hostile-audit-passed phi linear root and Q0*Q1^3 norm factorization; M3-T11-115 hostile-audit-passed d_rel=sf(C_u)*e_ext with actual extreme surplus retained; M3-T11-119 hostile-audit-passed Q0/Q1 conductor tails; M3-T11-121 hostile-audit-passed resultant/difference identity.
ALIASES=PhiFreshDifferenceSquareclassCollapse; PhiEvaluationDenominatorKappaCollapse; PhiDeltaQ0Allocation; PhiTwoFactorTwistNoDoubleCharge; JointMovingPhiParameterDenominatorSupportFirewall.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=Targeted MAIN, RESULT-LEDGER, CARD-INDEX, active ROUTE and NEGATIVE-REGISTER rematch performed for delta, evaluation denominator, sf(C_u), e_ext, Q0 allocation, two-factor twist and S4/theta routes. No prior card states the all-relative-fresh delta parity theorem or the exact fresh squareclass [z-vartheta]_rel=[sf(C_u)*e_ext,0]. M3-T11-115 already owns the ambient actual extreme odd-kernel e_ext, so the e_ext,0 factor below is explicitly not a new support coordinate.
DUPLICATE_OF=NONE.
SUPERSEDES=The open research instruction after M3-T11-121 to seek a new independent support receiver from moving phi parameters, signed delta and the actual evaluation denominator. It does not supersede M3-T11-121 itself, M3-T11-115, M3-T11-119, or any S4/theta theorem gate.


0. Notation and retained identities


For primitive phi parameters t=r/s, write
Q0=r^2+s^2,
Q1=r^2-4*r*s+5*s^2,
N=r^2-2*r*s-s^2,
K=r^2+2*r*s-s^2,
U=-2*s*(r-s)*N,
V=r^4-6*r^3*s+12*r^2*s^2-14*r*s^3+11*s^4,
with
U^2+V^2=Q0*Q1^3,
u=U/V,
vartheta=N/Q0.


Let
Q_u(z)=(1+u^2)z^4-8u*z^3+(11u^2-1)z^2+6u*z-u^2.
On the phi 1+3 image,
V^2*Q_u(z)=(Q0*z-N)*D(z),
where D is the audited cubic from M3-T11-121.


Write the physical symmetric coordinate in lowest terms as
S=sigma/tau,
and the exact physical quartic coordinate as
z=S/2=A_z/B_z,
gcd(A_z,B_z)=1, B_z>0.


Define
L=Q0*A_z-N*B_z,
D_h=d3*A_z^3+d2*A_z^2*B_z+d1*A_z*B_z^2+d0*B_z^3.
M3-T11-121 gives the exact physical norm relation
L*D_h=-Q0*Q1^3*R_z^2
for a rational R_z with the displayed denominator clearing absorbed into R_z, and
z-vartheta=L/(Q0*B_z).
Write
L=delta*y^2
with signed squarefree integer delta and y a positive integer after removing the exact square factor.


For p^lambda||M_rel let
c_p=v_p(C_u), 0<=c_p<=2lambda,
k_p=2lambda-c_p.
Let
kappa=sf_rel(C_u)
denote the squarefree kernel on the retained odd relative-fresh support only.


Let n_p=v_p(N_u) for the reduced common u, where N_u=A_u^2+B_u^2.
Define the retained extreme actual odd kernel from M3-T11-115
e_ext=product p
over p^lambda||M_rel with c_p=2lambda and n_p odd.
Define its Q0-allocated subfactor
e_ext,0=product p
over the same conditions with additionally p|Q0.
Then e_ext,0|e_ext and gcd(kappa,e_ext,0)=1.


1. Exact evaluation-denominator squareclass


Because
z=S/2=(sigma)/(2*tau)
in lowest terms,
B_z=2*tau/gcd(sigma,2).
Therefore for every retained odd relative-fresh p,
v_p(B_z)=v_p(tau)=k_p=2lambda-c_p.


Hence
v_p(B_z) mod 2 = c_p mod 2,
so exactly
sf_rel(B_z)=kappa.


The physical evaluation denominator therefore contributes no new relative-fresh squareclass beyond the already-consumed M3-T11-040 conductor allocation.


2. Universal fresh valuation of z from Pi


M3-T11-102 gives, for every relative-fresh p^lambda||M_rel,
v_p(Pi)=-4lambda
in lowest terms, with
Pi=4*u^2*S/(1+u^2).


At a fresh prime u is a p-adic unit and
v_p(1+u^2)=v_p(N_u)=n_p.
Thus
v_p(S)=n_p-4lambda,
and for odd p,
v_p(z)=n_p-4lambda.


The capped conductor identity is
c_p=min(n_p,4lambda)-2lambda.
Consequently:
- if c_p<2lambda, then n_p=2lambda+c_p and k_p=4lambda-n_p;
- if c_p=2lambda, then n_p>=4lambda and B_z is p-adically a unit, while any surplus n_p-4lambda occurs in the numerator of z.


3. Homogenized resultant-remainder identity


Substitute
A_z=(L+N*B_z)/Q0
into the exact cubic homogenization D_h.
Direct exact expansion gives


Q0^3*D_h
=
Q1^3*L^3
+4*B_z*N*A6*L^2
+B_z^2*Q1*B8*L
+2*B_z^3*Q1^2*N*K^3,


where
A6=
r^6-8r^5s+35r^4s^2-112r^3s^3+211r^2s^4-200rs^5+81s^6,


B8=
5r^8-16r^7s+44r^6s^2-256r^5s^3+486r^4s^4-80r^3s^5-292r^2s^6+160rs^7+29s^8.


In particular,
Q0^3*D_h == 2*B_z^3*Q1^2*N*K^3 mod L.


The exact resultants needed for fresh-unit checks are
Res_r(Q0,Q1)=32*s^4,
Res_r(Q0,N)=8*s^4,
Res_r(Q0,K)=8*s^4,
Res_r(Q0,A6)=18432*s^12,
Res_r(Q0,B8)=589824*s^16,
Res_r(Q1,N)=8*s^4,
Res_r(Q1,K)=72*s^4,
Res_r(Q1,A6)=2048*s^12,
Res_r(Q1,B8)=5308416*s^16.


Every retained odd relative-fresh phi prime is a split sum-of-two-squares prime and hence is not 2 or 3; primitiveness gives p not dividing s. Thus the relevant displayed cofactors are p-units in the allocation arguments below.


4. All-relative-fresh delta parity theorem


M3-T11-110 gives that a retained odd relative-fresh p divides exactly one of Q0,Q1 and
n_p=v_p(Q0)+3*v_p(Q1).


Case A: Q0 allocation.
Put v_p(Q0)=n_p and v_p(Q1)=0.


If n_p>2lambda, then v_p(z)=n_p-4lambda and v_p(vartheta)=-n_p are unequal, so v_p(z-vartheta)=-n_p.
Using
z-vartheta=L/(Q0*B_z),
one obtains:
- for n_p<4lambda, v_p(L)=k_p=4lambda-n_p, hence v_p(delta) == c_p mod 2;
- for n_p>=4lambda, v_p(L)=0, hence p does not divide delta.


The only tie is n_p=2lambda, equivalently c_p=0.
Then v_p(B_z)=v_p(Q0)=n_p. Write
v_p(L)=n_p+h, h>=0.
If h>0, the four terms of the exact identity in Section 3 have valuations
3n_p+3h,
3n_p+2h,
3n_p+h,
3n_p,
so the constant term is uniquely minimal and v_p(D_h)=0.
The physical norm relation gives
v_p(L)+v_p(D_h)-v_p(Q0)-3v_p(Q1)
=h,
which must be even because the quotient is a square.
For h=0 the conclusion is immediate.
Thus delta is also p-adically even at the c_p=0 tie.


Therefore on Q0 allocation:
p|sf_rel(delta) iff c_p is odd.


Case B: Q1 allocation.
Put e=v_p(Q1)>0, v_p(Q0)=0 and n_p=3e.


If n_p<4lambda, z has negative valuation while vartheta is a unit, so v_p(L)=0.
If n_p>4lambda, z has positive valuation while vartheta is a unit, so again v_p(L)=0.


The only tie is n_p=4lambda, equivalently c_p=2lambda with no norm surplus.
Then e=4lambda/3, so lambda=3m and e=4m is even.
Write h=v_p(L).
The four terms in Section 3 have valuations
3e+3h,
2h,
e+h,
2e.
If h<e, the unique minimum is 2h; if h>e, the unique minimum is 2e; if h=e, h is already even.
Combining each non-tie minimum with the physical square relation forces h-e even, hence h even because e is even.
Thus delta is a p-adic square at the tie as well.


Therefore no Q1-allocated relative-fresh prime occurs in sf_rel(delta).


Combining both allocation cases gives the exact identity
sf_rel(delta)=gcd(kappa,rad(Q0)).
Equivalently, delta sees exactly the odd-c_p part of the old C_u squareclass that is allocated to Q0, and nothing more.


5. Exact fresh squareclass of the physical root difference


M3-T11-121 gives
[z-vartheta]=[delta*Q0*B_z].


Primewise:
- sf_rel(B_z)=kappa;
- sf_rel(delta)=the Q0-allocated part of kappa;
- the fresh squareclass of Q0 contributes the same Q0-allocated kappa part in non-extreme strata, while at c_p=2lambda it can additionally contribute precisely the actual odd norm-surplus factor e_ext,0;
- c_p=0 contributes v_p(Q0)=2lambda, hence no Q0 squareclass;
- Q1-allocated extreme surplus is not visible in the linear difference.


The two Q0-allocated kappa copies cancel in squareclass. Therefore


boxed:
[z-vartheta]_rel=[kappa*e_ext,0].


This is an exact relative-fresh identity on the retained physical phi population.


Since M3-T11-115 already retains
d_rel=kappa*e_ext
with e_ext the full actual extreme odd kernel, and e_ext,0 is merely its Q0-allocated subfactor, the root-difference squareclass introduces no new independent support coordinate.


6. Two-factor twist firewall


From
L*D_h=-Q0*Q1^3*R_z^2
and
L=delta*y^2,
one may rewrite the complementary factor as
D_h=-delta*Q0*Q1^3*x^2
for a rational x obtained by dividing the physical square root by delta*y.


Conversely, multiplying these two twist equations recovers the original physical norm relation.


Thus the pair
L=delta*y^2,
D_h=-delta*Q0*Q1^3*x^2
is an exact repackaging of one norm-square equation plus the chosen squarefree part delta. It is not two independent conditions and cannot be charged twice.


7. Research consequence


The proposed M3-T11-121 continuation
T11SamePhysicalJointMovingPhiParameterTwistDenominator
is exhausted as an independent support/squareclass receiver.


The actual evaluation denominator, delta, and the two-factor twist split collapse to:
- the already-audited conductor squareclass kappa=sf(C_u);
- the already-audited actual extreme norm odd kernel e_ext, with only its Q0 suballocation visible here;
- allocation information already present in the phi Q0/Q1 conductor structure.


No new count, density factor, fixed-power saving, or support-cardinality theorem follows.


A future use of this geometry would require a genuinely new same-R<=B global correlation or counting theorem for realized moving (r,s), kappa and e_ext,0, not another primewise squareclass/resultant reformulation.


The legal next T11 frontier is therefore the already-audited nonlocal branch:
Interior2PiSquareclassGenus2S4EtaleSelmerSupport.
Primewise norm-only and ordinary Kummer routes remain frozen by M3-T11-105.
If that does not produce a same-measure global receiver, the next retained alternative is
ThetaFourthPowerMovingSupportBeyondKummer,
with the M3-T11-096 Kummer/2-isogeny firewall preserved.


IMPLIES=T11SamePhysicalJointMovingPhiParameterTwistDenominator retired as an independent support receiver; exact global fresh root-difference squareclass is kappa*e_ext,0; evaluation denominator fresh squareclass is kappa; delta fresh squareclass is the Q0-allocated part of kappa; two-factor twist split carries no second independent event.

Do not count L and D_h twists as independent conditions. Do not drop the actual extreme surplus e_ext. Do not identify vartheta=N/Q0 with the physical z. Do not revive the retracted M3-T11-120 physical root lock. Do not return to norm-only S4 or ordinary Kummer/2-isogeny local squareclasses as fresh saving.

records.title: M3-PESCH-TI-001-PESCHMANN-2604.28072-TORSION-INTERSECTION-ADAPTER

﻿M3-PESCH-TI-001 — Peschmann torsion-intersection fixed-source adapter


STATUS=PROVED_EXACT_ADAPTER / EXTERNAL_CORE_THEOREM_SCOPED_PASS
FINITE_1072_AGGREGATE_STATUS=HOLD
TYPE=EXACT_STRUCTURE / EXTERNAL_THEOREM_ADAPTER / FIBER_KILLER / TWO_SOURCE_RECEIVER
SOURCE=arXiv:2604.28072v1
AUDIT_DOC_ID=1Nc-9HIo6uaqWRTuFfimIzJXwE5d7O5BdAYPwUjSISfA
RELATED=M3-MASTER-001;M3-ONE-002;M3-ONE-005;M3-TERM-002
DUPLICATE_OF=none
GLOBAL_FIXED_POWER_SAVING=false
PRIMARY_GATE_CLOSED=false
P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false
PERFECT_CUBOID_NONEXISTENCE_CREDIT=false


1. Exact Stage37 dictionary


Fix the second primitive Euclid source p=(m,n), with
U2=m^2-n^2, V2=2mn, W2=m^2+n^2,
and write t=a/b for the first source.


Define
P_p(s)=V2^2 s^2+(4U2^2-2V2^2)s+V2^2,
Q_p(s)=W2^2 s^2+2(U2^2-V2^2)s+W2^2.


Direct substitution gives the exact identities
P_p(t^2)=M/b^4,
Q_p(t^2)=f1/b^4,
where
M=(V1 U2)^2+(U1 V2)^2
is the Master/M3 square condition and
f1=(W1 U2)^2+(U1 V2)^2
is the space-diagonal square condition.


Hence on the exact nondegenerate Stage37 M3 population, P_p(t^2) is already a nonzero rational square. Therefore
H_p: v^2=P_p(t^2)Q_p(t^2)
has a rational point above that physical M3 parameter t
if and only if Q_p(t^2) is a rational square,
equivalently if and only if that M3 object is an endpoint.


This is stronger than merely using H_p as a necessary relaxation: after conditioning on exact M3, H_p is an exact endpoint adapter at fixed second source.


2. Independently checked quotient geometry


The involutions t->-t, t->1/t, t->-1/t give the quotients
E_PQ: Y^2=P_p(s)Q_p(s), s=t^2,
E_uV: V^2=(V2^2 u^2+4(U2^2-V2^2))(W2^2 u^2-4V2^2), u=t+1/t,
E_3: V^2=(V2^2 w^2+4U2^2)(W2^2 w^2+4U2^2), w=t-1/t.


These formulas were independently rederived from P_p(t^2)Q_p(t^2)/t^4, so the Stage37 adapter does not rely solely on the companion-paper citation.


The paper's displayed resultant in section 3.1 contains a nonfatal algebraic error:
stated Res_s(P_p,Q_p)=256 U2^4 V2^4,
but direct symbolic calculation gives
Res_s(P_p,Q_p)=16 U2^8.
The corrected resultant is still nonzero for m>n, so the smooth genus-3 conclusion survives. The two displayed discriminants are correct.


3. Fiber-killer theorem imported into Stage37


Define TI_CLOSED(p) for a primitive source p=(m,n) when one of the following exact conditions holds for H_p:


A. rank E_3(Q)=0 and |E_3(Q)_tors|=4.


B. rank E_uV(Q)=0 and |E_uV(Q)_tors|=6.


C. rank E_uV(Q)=0, |E_uV(Q)_tors|=8, and the rational torsion lift count back to H_p is exactly 8.


Then H_p(Q) consists only of the eight degenerate points
t=0, t=+/-1, and the two points at infinity.
Therefore no nondegenerate Stage37 endpoint can have p as its fixed second Euclid source.


The proof is the degree-2 quotient count:
rank zero makes the quotient rational points torsion;
E_3 has no rational ramification because t^2=-1 has no rational solution;
E_uV has exactly four rational ramification points at t=+/-1;
the stated torsion/lift cardinalities force |H_p(Q)|<=8;
the eight known degenerate points give the matching lower bound.


4. Two-source consequence


By M3-MASTER-001 / the master-tuple reduction, every primitive canonical M3 object has two primitive Euclid source pairs p1 and p2. Swapping the two pairs swaps the two even-edge labels.


Therefore every perfect endpoint must satisfy
NOT TI_CLOSED(p1) AND NOT TI_CLOSED(p2).


Equivalently, if H_TI denotes the set of primitive source pairs not closed by the torsion-intersection criterion, then
P(B) <= #{E in M3(B): p1(E) in H_TI and p2(E) in H_TI}.


This is an exact two-source receiver. No independence assumption is used.


5. Canonical open gate


M3-PESCH-TI-GATE-001
TYPE=THEOREM_GATE
STATUS=OPEN
CLAIM:
Prove that the exact physical M3 mass on the two-hard-source locus is negligible:
#{E in M3(B): p1(E),p2(E) in H_TI}=o(M3(B)).
Any such theorem closes P(B)/M3(B)->0.


Stronger sufficient forms include a fixed-power deficit on the two-hard-source locus, or a same-R<=B weighted theorem showing that a sufficiently strong proportion of physical source mass is TI_CLOSED. A raw unweighted density of source pairs is not enough.


The natural new family target is E_3(p), because its closure criterion has no rational ramification correction. A uniform rank-zero/torsion theorem, or a weighted rank-distribution theorem on physical primitive Pythagorean sources, would feed this gate directly.


6. Scope and firewalls


The paper's generic torsion-intersection theorem is accepted here as an exact scoped Stage37 receiver.


The paper's claim that 1,072 explicit fibers are unconditionally certified is NOT promoted by this card. The full-literature audit found an implementation-description conflict between section 4.4 and Appendix B; see the audit receipt.


The finite list, even if fully certified, gives no asymptotic Stage37 saving by itself. The reusable value is the fixed-source fiber-killer criterion and its two-source consequence.

records.title: M3-T11-120
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-120 — Phi physical-root lock and Q1 fourth-power Gaussian conductor tail


STATUS=RETRACTED_PHYSICAL_ADAPTER / HOSTILE_REAUDIT_FAIL / NO_GLOBAL_POWER_SAVING
CORRECTION_DOC_ID_120=1Nu8yyS9qeeO2KInGVD4iSASUrQDazpXR
HISTORICAL_STATUS=PROVED_EXACT / HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_MOVING_MODULUS_COUNT / PHI_PHYSICAL_ROOT_LOCK / PHI_EXTREME_FRESH_SPLIT / PHI_Q1_GAUSSIAN_FOURTH_POWER / NO_GLOBAL_POWER_SAVING
AUDIT_DOC_ID=1MhAhyNSZwdimlySUQAvXF5LwKKTyr5DR3ZrWLefzc6o
TYPE=EXACT_PHYSICAL_CROSS_INVARIANT / SAME_MEASURE_PARAMETER_LATTICE_SUM / CONDUCTOR_HEIGHT_ROUTER / ANTI_LOOP_FIREWALL
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet, restricted to the audited phi/1+3 image. One endpoint is one count.
DEPENDENCIES=M3-T11-036 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS fixed-u B^o(1) physical multiplicity; M3-T11-102 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS exact Pi fresh valuation v_p(Pi)=-4lambda; M3-T11-106 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS physical z=S/2; M3-T11-109 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS unique rational root on the phi image; M3-T11-110 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS phi root N/Q0, Q0*Q1^3 norm factorization and odd coprimality; M3-T11-119 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS Q0 Gaussian tail and allocation notation.
ALIASES=PhiPhysicalRootLock; PhiExtremeFreshSplit; PhiQ1CubeConductorFourthPowerLift; PhiQ1GaussianFourthPowerMovingTail; PhiDualAllocationConductorTail.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=Current MAIN, RESULT-LEDGER, RESEARCH-INDEX, active ROUTE, NEGATIVE-REGISTER, CARD-INDEX and Drive search checked for PhiPhysicalRootLock, S=2N/Q0, M_phi,1 perfect cube, Q1 fourth-power Gaussian, 3|lambda on Q1 and H+H^2/sqrt(R0). No matching same-population result found. M3-T11-110 gives only Q1=>cubic resonance on the then-audited interior router; M3-T11-119 identifies the universal B1^3 cube but only proves M_phi,1<<H^3. DUPLICATE_OF=NONE.


1. Physical root lock


For primitive t=r/s retain
N=r^2-2*r*s-s^2,
Q0=r^2+s^2,
Q1=r^2-4*r*s+5*s^2,
U=-2*s*(r-s)*N,
V=r^4-6*r^3*s+12*r^2*s^2-14*r*s^3+11*s^4,
u=U/V.


Audited M3-T11-106 gives the exact physical quartic coordinate
z=S/2.


Audited M3-T11-109 says that on the nonzero rational phi image the residual quartic has exactly one rational root. Audited M3-T11-110 identifies that root as
vartheta=N/Q0.


Therefore every physical phi endpoint satisfies the exact cross-invariant identity
S/2=N/Q0,
hence
S=2N/Q0.


This uses the uniqueness of the rational root on the same physical endpoint. It is not a local-density argument.


Independent exact factorization gives
Q_u(z)=(Q0*z-N)*C_phi(r,s,z)/V^2
for an explicit cubic C_phi, confirming the same root line algebraically.


2. Exact Pi factorization


Retain the audited physical identity
Pi=4*u^2*S/(1+u^2).


Using S=2N/Q0 and the audited identity
U^2+V^2=Q0*Q1^3,
exact simplification gives
Pi=32*s^2*(r-s)^2*N^3/(Q0^2*Q1^3).


Independent Wolfram recomputation returns zero for the difference between the two sides.


For primitive (r,s), every odd prime divisor of Q0 or Q1 is coprime to s and N by the audited resultants
Res_r(N,Q0)=8*s^4,
Res_r(N,Q1)=8*s^4.
It is also coprime to r-s: if r==s mod p, then either Q0 or Q1 is congruent to 2*s^2 mod p, impossible for odd p unless p|r,s.


Thus no odd relative-fresh Q0/Q1 prime is cancelled by the displayed numerator.


3. Exact fresh-prime extreme split


Let p^lambda || M_rel be a retained odd relative-fresh prime.


Audited M3-T11-102 gives exactly
v_p(Pi)=-4*lambda.


Audited M3-T11-110 gives odd Q0/Q1 coprimality, so p divides exactly one of Q0,Q1.


Case Q0:
write e0=v_p(Q0).
The exact Pi factorization gives
-2*e0=-4*lambda,
so
e0=2*lambda.
Also
v_p(a^2+b^2)=e0=2*lambda.
Hence this is exactly the full-S-denominator extreme
c_p=0.


Case Q1:
write e1=v_p(Q1).
The exact Pi factorization gives
-3*e1=-4*lambda,
so
3*e1=4*lambda.
Therefore
lambda=3*k,
e1=4*k
for some k>=1. Also
v_p(a^2+b^2)=3*e1=4*lambda,
so this is exactly the amplified-u extreme
c_p=2*lambda.


Consequently on the physical phi image:
p|Q0 iff c_p=0,
p|Q1 iff c_p=2*lambda,
and on the Q1 side 3|lambda.


In particular the physical phi image has no relative-fresh primes in the strict interior range
0<c_p<2*lambda.


This does not retract M3-T11-110. Its earlier implication Q1=>cubic resonance remains valid but is now sharpened to an extreme valuation statement on actual physical phi endpoints.


4. Q1 conductor is a perfect cube with a Gaussian fourth-power divisor


Retain
M_phi,1=product_{p^lambda || M_rel, p|Q1} p^lambda.


By Section 3, every Q1 exponent is lambda=3*k. Therefore
M_phi,1=C1^3
for
C1=product p^k.


Let
B1=(r-2*s)+i*s,
so N(B1)=Q1.
For each Q1 fresh prime p, primitive Gaussian coprimality selects one unique orientation pi_p above p dividing B1, with
v_{pi_p}(B1)=v_p(Q1)=4*k.


Define
beta1=product pi_p^k.
Then
N(beta1)=C1
and
beta1^4 | B1.


Therefore
C1^4 | Q1.
Since for H=max(|r|,|s|),
Q1<=10*H^2,
one gets
C1<=10^(1/4)*H^(1/2),
and hence
M_phi,1<=10^(3/4)*H^(3/2).


This strictly improves the M3-T11-119 deterministic Q1 cap M_phi,1<<H^3.


5. Same-measure moving Q1 conductor tail


Fix c=C1. Up to bounded units there are at most 2^omega(c) Gaussian orientation choices for beta1.


From
B1=beta1^4*w
and
|B1|<=sqrt(10)*H,
while |beta1^4|=N(beta1)^2=c^2,
each fixed oriented beta1 supports
O(1+H^2/c^4)
integer Gaussian values w, after legal enlargement beyond the primitive/height constraints.


The linear map
(r,s) -> B1=(r-2s)+i*s
is integral and injective, so this counts phi parameters without introducing a second measure.


For M_phi,1>=M we have c>=M^(1/3). Summing all moving c and all orientations gives
sum 2^omega(c)*(1+H^2/c^4)
<< H^(1/2)*log(2H)+H^2*log(2M)/M,
up to fixed constants.


Using the audited M3-T11-036 fixed-realized-u B^o(1) physical multiplicity, and counting primitive t values as an overcount of distinct realized u values,
E_phi,1(B;H,M)
<< B^o(1)*min(H^2,H^(1/2)+H^2/M).


This is a same-R<=B replacement count. Gaussian orientation, perfect-cube structure and beta1^4 divisibility are fully summed costs, not independent probabilities.


6. Improved total relative-conductor tail


Retain from audited M3-T11-119 the Q0 tail
E_phi,0(B;H,M0>=X)
<<B^o(1)*min(H^2,H+H^2/X).


On retained fresh support
M_rel=M_phi,0*M_phi,1.


If M_rel>=R0, then for T=sqrt(R0) at least one of
M_phi,0>=T
or
M_phi,1>=T
holds.


Use a union bound on the same physical population, not a product of savings. Combining the Q0 and Q1 replacement counts gives
E_phi(B;H(t)<=H,M_rel>=R0)
<< B^o(1)*min(H^2,H+H^2/sqrt(R0)).


For H<=B^h and M_rel>=B^m this is
E_phi
<< B^{min(2h,max(h,2h-m/2))+o(1)}.


A sufficient one-twelfth window is
h<1/12
and
2h-m/2<1/12.


The deterministic caps
M_phi,0<<H
and
M_phi,1<<H^(3/2)
also give
M_rel<<H^(5/2),
improving M3-T11-119's H^4 deterministic cap.


No theorem here forces the whole phi population into the one-twelfth window.


7. Remaining phi theorem gate


The former Q1-dominant residual is no longer an unconstrained ordinary B1-cube branch. Its fresh support is forced entirely to the amplified-u extreme, with cube conductor exponent lambda=3k and an actual fourth-power Gaussian divisor beta1^4|B1.


The remaining missing ingredient is global occupancy/height control: prove that physical phi endpoints are forced either into a small-H shell or into sufficiently large M_rel / allocation conductor for the audited Q0/Q1 tails to beat the one-twelfth target.


Equivalently, seek a genuinely independent same-R<=B correlation between exact physical height and the extreme-support conductor split. Do not replay primewise resonance, Gaussian orientation, or the universal B1^3 cube as rarity.


FIREWALL:
- Do not multiply the Q0 and Q1 tails; the total-conductor theorem uses a union bound.
- Do not charge lambda divisible by 3, M_phi,1=C1^3, Gaussian orientations, beta1^4|B1, or cubic resonance as local probability factors.
- Do not infer a global lower bound on M_rel or parameter height.
- Do not infer a whole-phi fixed-power saving.
- Do not promote primary-gate closure, P(B)/M3(B), endpoint theorem, or Perfect Cuboid existence/nonexistence credit.
- M3-T11-043 remains valid: the amplified-u extreme has its own residual-valuation firewall. This card does not reopen its frozen Phi_* mechanism.


VERIFICATION:
Independent Wolfram Language recomputation verified:
Q_u(N/Q0)=0;
the exact linear factor Q0*z-N;
Pi=32*s^2*(r-s)^2*N^3/(Q0^2*Q1^3);
U^2+V^2=Q0*Q1^3;
Res_r(Q0,Q1)=32*s^4;
Res_r(N,Q0)=8*s^4;
Res_r(N,Q1)=8*s^4;
Q0|_{r=s}=Q1|_{r=s}=2*s^2.


CREDIT=Hostile-audit-promoted exact physical phi root lock; exact fresh-prime extreme split; Q1 perfect-cube/fourth-power Gaussian conductor structure; same-measure Q1 moving-modulus tail; improved total-conductor union tail. Zero global fixed-power/primary-gate/P-over-M3/Perfect-Cuboid credit.

## 1. First invalid inference


M3-T11-106 says the physical evaluation coordinate is z_phys=S/2. M3-T11-109/110 says that on the phi image the polynomial Q_u has a unique rational root vartheta=N/Q0. A rational evaluation point is not thereby a root. These two rational objects cannot be identified merely from the uniqueness of the polynomial's rational root.


The previously audited M3-T11-110 explicitly states: do not identify vartheta with physical z=S/2; vartheta is a root, whereas z is the evaluation point in the etale descent. M3-T11-105 gives the physical condition Q_u(z)/A=-w^2, not Q_u(z)=0.


Thus the opening root lock S=2N/Q0 in M3-T11-120 has no valid physical adapter. Substituting it in later algebra does not establish it on physical endpoints.


## 2. Exact discriminant certificate


Put A=1+u^2 and retain the actual symmetric cubic


f(X)=X^3-S*X^2+E*X-Pi,
E=4u(S-u)/A,
Pi=4u^2*S/A.


The standard cubic discriminant is


Delta=S^2*E^2-4E^3-4S^3*Pi-27Pi^2+18S*E*Pi.


Direct expansion gives the polynomial identity


A^3*Delta/(16u^2)
=A*S^2*(S-u)^2-16u*(S-u)^3-A^2*S^4-27u^2*A*S^2+18u*A*S^2*(S-u)
=-u^2*(A*S^4-16u*S^3+(44u^2-4)*S^2+48u*S-16u^2).

On the nonzero-discriminant locus this is a nonzero negative rational square. In particular z_phys is not any root of Q_u, including vartheta. If one forcibly sets z_phys=vartheta, Delta=0 and the symmetric cubic has repeated roots: this is the branch/degenerate locus, not the distinct-root physical adapter used in the retained descent.


This does NOT prove the whole physical phi population empty. The condition z_phys=vartheta was never proved for that population, so contradiction after imposing it cannot eliminate phi.


## 3. Withdrawal scope and retained results


Withdraw M3-T11-120's physical claims:


- S=2N/Q0 and the resulting physical Pi formula;
- Q0 iff c_p=0, Q1 iff c_p=2lambda, and strict-interior phi support empty;
- 3|lambda on all Q1 physical fresh primes, M_phi,1=C1^3, beta1^4|B1;

The computations made AFTER imposing the root lock, including the special Pi expression, are algebraic conditional identities only. They are not physical theorems. Historical proof text and historical audit remain retained and explicitly superseded by this correction.


Retain independent audited M3-T11-119:


U+iV=i*conj(r+i*s)*((r-2s)+i*s)^3,

Retain M3-T11-118's fixed norm-squareclass theorem and its 119 feasibility caveat. Retain M3-T11-110's actual interior Q0/Q1 allocation and Q1=>cubic resonance, with no converse or local-density credit. Retraction of the interior-empty claim does not prove that physical interior points exist; their occupancy remains open.


## 4. Correct continuation gate


On the phi polynomial factorization Q_u(z)=A*(z-vartheta)*C_u^(3)(z), with C_u^(3) monic cubic, the true physical relation is

Do not replay the frozen local tuple.

﻿M3-T11-119 — Phi Q0 Gaussian square-conductor lattice tail and Q1 cube saturation


STATUS=PROVED_EXACT / HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS / EXACT_SAME_MEASURE_MOVING_MODULUS_COUNT / PHI_Q0_GAUSSIAN_SQUARE_DIVISOR / PHI_Q1_CUBE_ANTI_LOOP / NO_GLOBAL_POWER_SAVING\nAUDIT_DOC_ID=1aN_8wZPIP8kRIOoPyJnjzgJvnmVRU3kju-M7qRcobGU
TYPE=THEOREM_CANDIDATE / SAME_MEASURE_PARAMETER_LATTICE_SUM / CONDUCTOR_HEIGHT_ROUTER / ANTI_LOOP_FIREWALL
POPULATION=Exact nondegenerate Stage37 physical endpoints with R<=B in one fixed content/coefficient packet, restricted to the audited phi/1+3 image. One endpoint is one count.
DEPENDENCIES=M3-T11-036 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS fixed-u B^o(1) physical multiplicity; M3-T11-109 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS phi parametrization; M3-T11-110 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS Q0*Q1^3 norm factorization and odd coprimality; M3-T11-118 HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS definition of M_phi,0 and current residual split.
ALIASES=PhiQ0GaussianSquareDivisorTail; PhiMovingSquareConductorLatticeSum; PhiQ1GaussianCubeSaturation; PhiTotalRelativeConductorHeightWindow.
DUPLICATE_SEARCH=RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE, NEGATIVE-REGISTER and Drive search checked for M_phi,0 Gaussian lattice, Phi Q0 square conductor lattice, H^2/M phi Q0, H+H^2/M, Q0 square-divisor tail, and PhiQ0AllocationConductorTail lattice. No matching same-population theorem found. Older Gaussian determinant/lattice cards concern different carriers or lack the fixed-u physical adapter. DUPLICATE_OF=NONE.


1. Exact Gaussian linear-cube factorization


For primitive t=r/s define
A0=r+i*s,
B1=(r-2*s)+i*s,
Q0=N(A0)=r^2+s^2,
Q1=N(B1)=(r-2*s)^2+s^2,
and retain
U=-2*s*(r-s)*(r^2-2*r*s-s^2),
V=r^4-6*r^3*s+12*r^2*s^2-14*r*s^3+11*s^4.


Exact expansion gives
U+i*V = i*conj(A0)*B1^3,
U-i*V = -i*A0*conj(B1)^3.


Hence N(U+iV)=Q0*Q1^3, recovering audited M3-T11-110, but now with the Gaussian orientations exposed before taking norms. Also
Res_r(Q0,Q1)=32*s^4,
so for primitive (r,s) every common odd rational prime divisor of Q0 and Q1 is impossible.


This factorization is structural. It is not by itself a saving.


2. Q0 allocation gives an actual Gaussian square-conductor divisor


Retain
M_phi,0 = product_{p^lambda || M_rel, p|Q0} p^lambda.


Every relative-fresh prime is odd split. Audited common-u saturation gives M_rel^2 | a^2+b^2. On the phi image, reduction of U/V cancels only powers of 2 and p|Q0 is odd-coprime to Q1, so
v_p(Q0)>=2*lambda.


Because gcd(r,s)=1, for p=pi*conj(pi) exactly one of pi,conj(pi) divides A0. Therefore for the actual orientation there is a Gaussian integer alpha_0 such that
alpha_0 | A0,
N(alpha_0)=M_phi,0^2.


For a fixed integer m=M_phi,0, the possible associated alpha_0 up to associates are at most 2^omega(m), up to the bounded unit factor. Since H=max(|r|,|s|),
|A0|=sqrt(Q0)<=sqrt(2)*H.
Writing A0=alpha_0*z gives
|z|<=sqrt(2)*H/m.


Thus for fixed m and orientation,
# {primitive phi parameters (r,s) of height <=H compatible with alpha_0}
<= # {z in Z[i]: |z|<=sqrt(2)*H/m}
<< 1+H^2/m^2.
Dropping primitivity only enlarges the count.


Summing over all moving m>=M and all orientations gives
sum_{M<=m<=sqrt(2)H} 2^omega(m)*(1+H^2/m^2)
<< H*log(2H) + (H^2/M)*log(2M),
using 2^omega(n)=sum_{d|n} mu^2(d), dyadic summation, and the standard elementary divisor-sum bounds.


Audited M3-T11-036 gives B^o(1) exact physical endpoints for each realized u in one fixed packet. Since u=phi(t) and counting primitive t values only overcounts distinct u values, for every fixed A with H<=B^A,


E_phi,0(B;H,M)
:= # {exact physical phi endpoints admitting primitive t of height <=H and M_phi,0>=M}


satisfies


E_phi,0(B;H,M)
<<_A B^o(1) * min(H^2, H + H^2/M).


This is one replacement count on the same physical measure. No determinant factor is multiplied into a pre-existing endpoint bound.


3. Genuine exponent window and scope correction to the usefulness of the 118 tail


Since M_phi,0^2 | Q0 and Q0<=2H^2,
M_phi,0<=sqrt(2)*H.
Thus in exponent notation H<=B^h, M_phi,0>=B^m0, every nonempty asymptotic shell has m0<=h+o(1).


The audited 118 bound
E_phi<<B^o(1)*min(H^2,H^4/M_phi,0^2)
is correct, but on the feasible range M_phi,0<=sqrt(2)H its second term does not improve the ambient H^2 exponent. Its one-twelfth condition 4h-2m0<1/12 can only beat the one-twelfth target when the ambient 2h is already at least as good.


The new Gaussian moving-modulus sum gives instead
E_phi,0 << B^{min(2h, max(h,2h-m0))+o(1)}.
For m0>0 this is a genuine improvement over the ambient 2h exponent, down to the floor h when m0 approaches h.


A sufficient one-twelfth window is
h<1/12
and
2h-m0<1/12.
This can hold while 2h>=1/12, so it is strictly stronger than ambient parameter counting.


No statement of M3-T11-118 is retracted; only the exponent usefulness of its H^4/M0^2 term on the actual feasible Q0-allocation range is clarified.


4. Q1 allocation has only an ordinary Gaussian divisor and a height cap


Define the complementary fresh allocation
M_phi,1 = product_{p^lambda || M_rel, p|Q1} p^lambda.


Odd coprimality of Q0,Q1 and M_rel^2|a^2+b^2 imply
M_rel=M_phi,0*M_phi,1
on the retained relative-fresh support.


For p^lambda|M_phi,1, write e_p=v_p(Q1). Audited M3-T11-110 gives
3*e_p=v_p(a^2+b^2)>=2*lambda,
so e_p>=ceil(2*lambda/3).


Equivalently, if pi_p is the unique Gaussian prime above p dividing B1, then
Gamma_1=product pi_p^ceil(2*lambda/3)
divides B1.
Its norm
K_1=N(Gamma_1)=product p^ceil(2*lambda/3)
satisfies
K_1>=M_phi,1^(2/3)
and
K_1|Q1.


Since
Q1=(r-2s)^2+s^2<=10H^2,
one gets the deterministic cap
M_phi,1 <= Q1^(3/2) <= 10^(3/2)*H^3.


The exact identity U+iV=i*conj(A0)*B1^3 shows why the local Q1 cubic orientations are globally compatible: they are the local prime factors of the single global cube B1^3. Therefore a cross-prime argument that only combines those Gaussian orientations or the already-audited cubic-resonance labels supplies no additional rarity event. A new Q1 theorem must use information beyond this universal cube divisibility.


5. Combined total-relative-conductor window


Let R0>=1 and restrict to physical phi endpoints with H(t)<=H and M_rel>=R0.
From
M_rel=M_phi,0*M_phi,1
and
M_phi,1<=10^(3/2)H^3,
one has
M_phi,0 >= R0/(10^(3/2)H^3).


Insert this lower bound into Section 2. Uniformly for polynomial H,R0,


E_phi(B; H(t)<=H, M_rel>=R0)
<< B^o(1) * min(
